athenaOutput.directive: The Creative Liberation Engine has already strategically committed to implementing a sovereign, intelligent token optimization layer, primarily leveraging TOON for structured LLM inputs. This directive reinforces the existing architectural decision and prioritizes its complete and robust realization.
athenaOutput.rationale: Prior ATHENA decisions, captured in the KEEPER archives, explicitly state the commitment to 'implement a sovereign, intelligent token optimization layer, primarily leveraging TOON for structured LLM inputs and maintaining robust, schema-validated JSON for machine-parseable outputs.' The provided article, while informative, details a concept already integrated into the Creative Liberation Engine's strategic roadmap. Therefore, further ideation on the core concept of TOON for token optimization is redundant, as the foundational decision has been made. The focus should now shift to the architectural specification and implementation (PLAN mode) of this pre-approved capability.
